user_query: I want to find an API that can convert numbers to spelled-out format in different languages for my voice-activated assistant.

TaskList.description: Research available APIs that provide number-to-text conversion functionality across multiple languages.
Evaluate the APIs found in step 1 based on their language support and rule sets.
Select the most suitable API based on the evaluation in step 2.
Implement the selected API into the voice-activated assistant system.
